spec_match.rationale: Drives the exact css-text-decor-4 surface: one- and two-value forms, px/%/em units, negative values, and a computed-style read-back showing the shorthand expansion.

interactive.rationale: Unit select, two range sliders and a link-ends checkbox all re-render the rule, specimen and computed table live; verified slider and unit changes updated every readout.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises driving both ends with computed read-back and that is exactly the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Negative insets, the one-value shorthand, percentage resolution and the unsupported browser each have a distinct, explained state.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5178263526834176 and the property definition in CSS Text Decoration 4.

conformance.rationale: The suite asserts the length/percentage/auto/two-value/negative parse contracts plus a render check; on Chromium 141 the route honestly reported 0 pass / 8 fail because the property genuinely needs Chrome 154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): exercised sliders and the unit select — rule updated to 'text-decoration-inset: 40% 0%', computed table honestly read 'not supported', amber banner correct; console clean, no failed same-origin requests, desktop and mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and emits an inset-applied assert with declared/computed/supported on each render.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, amber unsupported banner, focusable rule block, captioned computed table.

accessibility.rationale: Every control is labelled with a live value span, the readout is aria-live, and the checkbox sits in a 44px inline label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read); controls stack via auto-fit grid.

openQuestions.title: Fix the note's 'range below' wording
openQuestions.detail: The negative-values note ends 'the reason the range below goes below zero', but the sliders sit above the note, not below it. One-word copy fix ('the range above').

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/css-text-decoration-inset/inset-lab/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), which predates the property (CSS.supports false). The page is a model of the browser-version exception: an amber banner explains the full-width fallback, the generated rule and computed-readback table keep teaching (computed row honestly shows 'not supported'), and every control still works. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN cert artifact; desktop 1280 and mobile 360 DPR3 screenshots read with no overflow; /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 8 fail on this build. Only a one-word copy nit remains.
